title: Swirling Blue Orbs Over Hills
description: A vibrant landscape painting depicts rolling green and golden hills with dark treelines under a dramatic sky. Large blue spheres of varying sizes float throughout a swirling vortex of red, orange, and yellow brushstrokes, with a bright sun visible on the horizon.
prompt: A surreal landscape painting featuring rolling hills in shades of green and golden yellow with dark treelines, beneath a dramatic swirling sky of vibrant red, orange, and yellow brushstrokes. Numerous large solid blue spheres and smaller blue dots float throughout the composition, with a bright glowing sun on the horizon. Bold, expressive style with visible brushwork.
